{{RequisiteWeapon|Ingredient For = {{Weapon|Twin Basolk}}}} {{Top|Enemy|Grineer|Grineer|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|This particle cannon generates a condensed beam of super-heated plasma designed to melt rock to ore, and enemies to molten slag.}} The '''Atomos''' is a [[Grineer]] particle cannon, firing a {{D|Heat}}-based beam that can chain between multiple enemies. This weapon can be sold for {{cc|2,500}}; it is also a [[weapon crafting ingredient]] for {{Weapon|Twin Basolk}}. {{Checklist|nocategory=true| * {{Weapon|Dual Zoren}} + {{Weapon|Atomos}} → {{Weapon|Twin Basolk}} }} ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals {{D|Heat}} damage. *Damage ramps up from 35% to 100% over 0.6 seconds when firing. After firing stops for 0.8 seconds, the damage decays back to 35% over 2 seconds. *Beam can chain up to '''3''' nearby enemies within '''7''' meters of each other, with each chain doing '''75%''' of the previous chain's damage. **Enemy corpses will still allow the beam to connect to nearby enemies. *{{M|Magnum Force}}'s [[accuracy]] penalty is minimal on this weapon. *Innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity. {{Advantages|class=Pistol|trigger=Held| }} {{Disadvantages|class=Pistol|trigger=Held| *Main beam has a limited range of 15 meters. **{{M|Ruinous Extension}} can be equipped to extend the maximum range. *Chain beam has a limited range of 7 meters. **Chain beam range cannot be increased with {{M|Ruinous Extension}}. *[[Ammo#Ammo_Pickup|Ammo from Pickups]] is 3.5 times lower (20) than ammo in magazine (70), leading to poor ammo efficiency. **{{M|Pistol Ammo Mutation}} ({{M|Primed Pistol Ammo Mutation|Prime}}) can be equipped to convert other ammo pickup types. }} ==Acquisition== The Atomos's blueprint can be purchased from the [[Market]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *When fired at an enemy, the beam will chain to the closest living enemy within 7 meters of the initial target. From there it will chain again, up to a maximum of 3 chains in total. A chain will do {{MathText|0.75{{exp|n}}}} times the main beam's damage, where '''n''' is the chain number. Any enemy caught in the width of the beam will also be damaged. It has a small radius of damage around the beam, similar to the {{Weapon|Ignis}} and {{Weapon|Embolist}}. **The damages are : '''100%''' for the main target, '''75%''' for the first in the chain, '''56.25%''' for the 2nd, and '''42.1875%''' for the 3rd. **Headshotting the original target does not affect the chain damage. **The beam '''will not''' chain to a [[Nullifier Crewman|Nullifier]] through its shield should it connect with a target outside or partially enclosed by it. **The beam can also continue to chain to enemies even if targeting a dead enemy or an enemy who is dead but in a dying animation. *The Atomos' innate {{D|Heat}} element is positioned last when adding elemental damage mods to the weapon. **Because of this Heat property and ability to chain, the Atomos is functionally similar to the Corpus {{Weapon|Tenet Cycron}}. *The Atomos covers up part of the reticle when aiming. This combined with the beams behavior of slowly rotating around a central point means that occasionally the beam will fire behind the weapon with no way of knowing if you are aiming at the enemy or not. *[[Punch Through]] will cause the main beam to chain independently from each additional target hit, potentially doubling or tripling the total damage output when fired into a crowd. The chain from the target hit after the Punch Through can deal damage to the first target, and vice versa. ==Incarnon Genesis== {{Transclude|Atomos Incarnon Genesis#Acquisition}} {{Transclude|Atomos Incarnon Genesis#Incarnon Genesis}} ==Tips== *{{M|Ruinous Extension}} can be used to extend this weapon's reach, allowing it to hit targets further away. *{{M|Pistol Ammo Mutation}} ({{M|Primed Pistol Ammo Mutation|Prime}}) can be used to convert other ammo pickup types to account for its below-magazine Ammo from Pickups. *{{M|Lethal Momentum}} can be used to increase its Incarnon Form [[Projectile Speed]]. *The [[Exilus_Weapon_Adapter|Exilus slot]] has an innate {{Pol|Madurai}} polarity, which is compatible to {{M|Lethal Momentum}} but not {{M|Pistol Ammo Mutation}} ({{M|Primed Pistol Ammo Mutation|Prime}}) or {{M|Ruinous Extension}}. If you plan to use the latter two, remember to [[Polarization#Notes|Swap Polarity]] before using another [[Forma]] or [[Omni Forma]]. ==Trivia== *''Atomos'' is the Greek word for "undivided", and is the origin of the word ''Atom'', referring to the smallest constituents of physical matter identifiable as a chemical element. *''Anastomosis'' is a Greek word meaning the reconnecting of various streams, such as in blood vessels or river deltas. *As of the release of Atomos, it is now possible to have a loadout consisting of purely {{D|Heat}} damage, combined with {{Weapon|Ignis}}, {{Weapon|Silva & Aegis}} ([[Silva & Aegis Prime|Prime]]) or{{Weapon|Twin Basolk}}, and {{WF|Chroma}} ([[Chroma Prime|Prime]]) (with the appropriate energy color) or {{WF|Ember}} ([[Ember Prime|Prime]]). **Before the release of Atomos, the closest one could get to this effect was with using a {{Weapon|Tysis}} that was heavily modified for {{D|Heat}} and [[Status Chance]]. *Ground-based enemies (e.g. [[Corpus]] [[Crewman|Crewmen]], [[Infested]] [[Charger]]s etc.) slain by the Atomos will char or appear to be coated in ash, and then disintegrate. Like the {{Weapon|Glaxion}}'s special effects, this effect occurs even if the Atomos is modified to deal a different kind of damage. *When reloading, two sections are removed and subsequently replaced individually, unlike other weapons. It can be speculated that one could be fuel and the other an igniting agent or propellant. ==Bugs== *The Atomos's visual effects will not go through {{WF|Volt}}'s {{A|Electric Shield}}, but it will interact with the shield normally (critical damage bonus, range boost, etc.) *If a Tenno is currently firing the Atomos when they are revived from the downed state, the visual and audio effects of the beam may become stuck at that position and randomly target enemies or even fellow allies for the remainder of the mission. (If stuck to a Tenno it will follow them all the way to extraction, resulting in further eyesore as it clips through the entire map and all terrain to do so.) **However the bugged beam does no damage and is purely an aesthetic issue. *Sometimes if you reload the magazine for the Atomos, it will not attach to the gun but it will have a full magazine. Just reload the gun to fix this as this does not affect the gun's use. ==Media== AtomosCodex.png|Atomos in Codex. Update16_5_Day3Weapons-GrnHeatGun.jpg|Preview image of the Atomos. {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|RVFcM-9yJp8|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|e4bdINqG5mA|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|xEWFW2SJGks|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|nl4aNfjpW9A|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|BoT1gPJVbI4|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|38}} *Fixed Wall Latching with the Atomos resulting in breaking their weapon holsters. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Secondary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 20 Ammo per Pick Up: *Atomos {{ver|30.3}} *Fixed arm cannon type (Atomos) reticle area being blocked by a part of Zephyr Harrier's shoulder element. {{ver|30.0.7}} *Added updated wrist-mounted weapon animations (ie Atomos). **Also fixes weird wrist angled animations. {{ver|29}} *Fixed script error with the Atomos. {{ver|28}} *Fixed arm mounted Secondaries (Atomos) not playing custom idle animations. As reported here: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1082719-arm-mounted-secondaries-broken-animation-thigh-holster-problem/ {{ver|23}} *Fixed Atomos missing its beam chain FX. {{ver|22.14}} *Fixed Beam weapons not being able to damage enemies (alive but in a ragdolled state) when being affected by certain ‘crowd control’ Abilities. *Damage now ramps up over 0.6 seconds and after moving off target there is a delay of 0.8 seconds before it starts to decay over 2 seconds. *All Beam weapons now start their Damage ramp up at 20% (instead of 10%). *The Multishot chance should now apply more consistently with Beam weapons. *Weapon Range Mods (like Sinister Reach) no longer affect the distance of chains for chainable Beam weapons (like the Amprex). Main Beam distance is still affected by them. *Fixed Beam weapons continuously firing when quick Meleeing. *Chain Range increased from 4m to 7m. {{ver|22.13.4}} *Increased the Beam weapon Damage ramp up time from 0.8 to 1 second. *Fixed Beam weapon Damage ramp up not happening per target. {{ver|22.13.3}} *Perfect accuracy and high fire rate is balanced by limited range and damage ramping up from when continuously firing the Atomos. {{ver|18.5}} *Fixed the Atomos causing Mag’s Bullet Attractor bubble to turn black when hit. {{ver|17.8}} *Fixed the Atomos not properly alerting enemies on use. {{ver|17.4}} *Fixed some lingering visual FX from Atomos when used with Mirage’s Hall of Mirrors. {{ver|17}} *Atomos damage increased in PvP. {{ver|16.9}} *Fixed an issue causing Atomos particle effects to hover in mid-air after being fired. {{ver|16.5.6}} *Fixed a visual bug related to using the Atomos on certain enemies. {{ver|16.5}} *Introduced. }} {{ver/Lu|24.1.5}} ==See Also== ==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*'''Argon Scope''' is additive with similar mods. For example, a {{Weapon|Snipetron}} with a max rank '''Argon Scope''' and {{M|Point Strike}} will have a {{Math|30% {{mul}} (1 + 135% + 150%)|t=y|p=y}} [[critical chance]].
*Argon Scope will trigger upon any weakpoint hits, whether the target survives or not.
**Weakpoint hits will refresh Argon Scope's timer.
**The weakpoint hit that triggers Argon Scope will not benefit from the buff itself (unless the buff was already active).
**Most weakpoints are eligible to trigger the effect, a few however do not have the "head" body part tag (e.g., {{E|MOA}} backpacks).
**When using a projectile weapon such as [[bows]], you must continue aiming until the projectile has hit its target to benefit from the buff.
*If activated, Argon Scope will display an icon timer beside the player's health UI, and the Warframe will be briefly surrounded by a flashing energy ribbon.
**This icon is the same as {{M|Hydraulic Crosshairs}} and {{M|Cat's Eye}} and features the {{Stat|Critical Chance|icon=only}} four-leaf clover.
*Can be installed alongside {{M|Point Strike}} or {{M|Critical Delay}} in order to further increase the [[critical chance]].

{{Top|Lotus|Tenno|Tenno|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Blast enemies with glass slugs that devastate on impact. In Gara's hands, this signature weapon has a larger Ammo Pool.}} The '''Astilla''' is {{WF|Gara}}'s [[Signature Weapon|signature]] shotgun, firing glass slugs that explode and damage nearby enemies in a small radius. With strong {{D|Impact}} and {{D|Slash}} damage, this weapon stuns and bleeds enemies with ease. When in Gara's hands, the shotgun holds more [[Ammo Maximum]]. This weapon can be sold for {{cc|7,500}}. ==Characteristics== *This weapon primarily deals {{D|Slash}} damage. *Fires a single slug every shot instead of individual pellets. **Slugs have a guaranteed {{D|Impact}} proc. *Slugs explode in a '''2.4''' meter radius after impacting a surface or enemy. **Initial hit and explosion apply status separately. **Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. *Innate {{Pol|Madurai}} and {{Pol|Naramon}} polarities. {{Advantages|class=Shotgun| *Tied with {{Weapon|Astilla Prime}} for the highest [[accuracy]] of all shotguns. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Shotgun| *Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% from 40m to 60m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *Fewer status counts due to firing a single projectile instead of multiple pellets. *Projectiles have travel time. *Shatter area of effect cannot hit enemies behind the location of impact. *Explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. *Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions. *Explosion has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 70% from central impact. }} {{WeaponComparison|Astilla Prime}} ==Acquisition== The Astilla's blueprint can be purchased from the [[Market]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *As a [[Signature Weapon]], Astilla gains a bonus effect with {{WF|Gara}} or {{WF|Gara Prime}}, gaining an additional '''80''' [[Ammo Maximum]], for a total of '''192'''. *The Astilla fires an explosive slug rather than a traditional spread of pellets. **This is similar to the {{Weapon|Arca Plasmor}}, which also uses shotgun mods but does not use pellets. *The slug loses accuracy with distance, and can be seen to veer off randomly past a certain point. *Because of the weapon's firing mechanics, the Astilla can be practically treated as a mid-ranged assault rifle that uses shotgun mods. But due to the explosive effects of its slugs, the gun is deceptively effective at crowd control. ==Tips== *{{M|Fatal Acceleration}} can be added to increase flight speed, as well as increasing minimum and maximum damage falloff penalty ranges to 56 and 84 meters respectively. **{{M|Galvanized Acceleration}} is practically better, but it consumes far more modding points. *Due to the low ammo pool and slug mechanics it is recommended to treat the Astilla not like an automatic shotgun but instead like an automatic explosive rifle. ==Trivia== *''"[[wiktionary:astilla|Astilla]]"'' is Spanish for "splinter". *Upon reloading, the Astilla makes a loud "ping" noise in a manner similar to the [[wikipedia:M1 Garand|M1 Garand]], an American semi-automatic rifle. ==Media== Weapon_GlassGun.jpg Screenshot_489.png|Astilla in Arsenal Screenshot_490.png {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|nvU0KD1FF_c|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|I3G0RrHrmrg|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|Zr3y-qjd_vo|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|pMFAGDXrj-8|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|Uub7Mjer8nk|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|35.5.8}} *Fixed the glass on Astilla being very bright in GI lighting areas. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 40 Ammo per Pick Up: *Astilla ;Headshot Damage Changes During playtesting, the ammo changes alone weren’t enough to significantly change things for AoE weapons. So instead of tightening these values to be overly restrictive, we chose to address other factors that make these weapons so strong, such as headshot damage. Our approach here is two-fold, to reduce the impact of headshots for AOE weapons, but to also make precision headshots pack a larger punch overall. *Radial damage no longer gains extra headshot damage or triggers headshot conditions. **This is primarily targeted at the Ignis Wraith - as a “flamethrower” weapon, it’s hard to imagine a blanket of elements being precise enough to target weak points specifically. Explosive projectiles themselves can still land headshots, so there is still a reason to aim with most weapons for maximum damage. {{ver|27.2.2}}
Reduced the following AoE weapons Radial Damage Falloff from central impact that were all previously 90%: *Astilla: 30% {{ver|27.2}} ;Self Damage Changes: We are getting rid of Self Damage and replacing it with something else: instead of Self Damage, it’s now ‘Stagger’. This change completely removes the chance of killing yourself, and instead now creates scenarios where you will interrupt yourself - or ‘Stagger’ - to varying degrees if you aren’t careful. The degrees of Self-Interrupt start with a small stumble all the way to full knockdown depending on how close you are to the center of explosion. Any Mods referring to Self Damage will be converted to acknowledge Stagger. With this Self-Interrupt system, we have added dozens of new recovery animations that harness a ninja-like recovery experience. By pressing ‘Jump’ at the correct time, you can execute a ninja-skill-based knockdown recovery to ALL in-game knockdowns. This ninja recovery window is indicated by a glowing FX on your Warframe. In addition to Self Damage being removed, some of the more powerful AOE weapons without Self Damage presently will have the Stagger added, but it should only be noticeable in cases of extreme inaccuracy on the player’s part. The Weapons include: *Astilla In the original Dev Workshop, we said:
''As a result of this overall systemic change, Weapons with Stagger will be getting approximately a 20% buff in Damage, with any weapons with AOE receiving a 50% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact.'' This is no longer accurate after continued testing. What we are doing now is: No damage buffs have been added, but any weapons with AOE are receiving ~20% increase in Radius. Additionally, AOE weapons are receiving a 90% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact. This means on the very outer section of the explosion Radius 10% of the Damage will be dealt. Tactics will be deadly - aim true, Tenno. ''Why: Several players brought up the history of the Tonkor and we want to make sure we ship this change in a place that’s conservative in its starting point from a balance perspective. The complete removal of Self Damage does change the pace of destruction with some of the game’s most powerful weapons, so we want to make sure we can iterate upwardly instead of releasing a bonanza of explosions with no other choices.'' {{Ver|24.6}} *Having a ‘signature’ weapon now actually benefits you! **Astilla: Additional 80 ammo pool when wielded by Gara. {{ver|22.12}} *Mastery Rank increased from 7 to 10. {{ver|Plains of Eidolon}} *Introduced. }} {{ver/Lu|24.3.3}} ==See Also== *{{Weapon|Fusilai}}, {{WF|Gara}}'s signature throwing knives. *{{Weapon|Volnus}}, Gara's signature hammer. *{{Weapon|Astilla Prime}}, the [[Prime]]d counterpart of this weapon. {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Astilla]] [[es:Astilla]] [[Category:Update 22]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Shotgun]] [[Category:Signature Weapons]] [[Category:Slash Damage Weapons]] [[uk:Астіла]]

{{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}}
{{Codex|Pick off targets by highlighting distant enemies using this Grineer rifle's advanced laser sighting system. Deadly in both single fire and automatic modes.}}
The '''Argonak''' is a {{Faction|Grineer}} assault rifle that highlights enemies close to the reticle when aiming as long as they are within range, increasing visibility in dark areas. Its semi-auto main fire can be quickly changed to its secondary automatic mode to engage enemies with a faster fire rate and increased [[status chance]] at the cost of lowering [[critical chance]].

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Slash}} damage.
*When aiming, highlights enemies within a 100m range using weapon's energy color, increasing visibility.
*Can use the Argonak-exclusive {{M|Amalgam Argonak Metal Auger}} mod.
*Innate {{Pol|Madurai}} and one {{Pol|Naramon}} polarities.

{{Advantages|
*Semi-auto mode has high zoom, increasing its effectiveness at longer ranges.
}}

{{Disadvantages|
*Semi-auto mode's high zoom impairs close quarter combat capability.
}}

==Acquisition==
The Argonak's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Chem Lab|Chem Lab]] in the [[dojo]].

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Notes==
*The Argonak has two fire modes, semi-auto as its main fire mode and fully automatic mode as its secondary. Its main fire mode has good [[status chance]] and high [[critical chance]], while the secondary mode allows automatic fire and increased [[status chance]] at the cost of reduced [[critical chance]].
**The firing sounds of both fire modes are different. The sound of the semi-auto mode is louder and has a higher pitch akin to a high-powered rifle while the fully automatic mode is quieter and sounds similar to a sub-machine gun.
*The Argonak's main feature is its target-highlighting scope that functions whilst zoomed in;
**Highlights targets in the color selected on the appearance energy slot.
**Highlight range of 100 meters.
**Targets must be within relatively close proximity of the crosshair to highlight; will not light up all enemies on screen.
**''Only'' highlights enemies; will not highlight objects, squadmembers, [[Companion]]s, or other allied forces (e.g. in Invasions or Syndicate Missions).
**Highlights enemies through most obscuring conditions like fog or smoke, making it much easier to spot enemies in poor visibility situations.
*Pitch of shots changes on the last 8 rounds letting you know you are near empty. This varies depending on magazine size.
*A magazine size of 43 rounds can make the weapon feel a little sluggish to use, however when used in semi-auto mode the magazine size seems more manageable.
*The zoom level is increased when aiming in semi-auto mode.

==Tips==
*The high criticals and good status chance of the main semi-auto mode makes it good for obtaining critical slash procs, which can quickly bleed enemies through their armor.
**The full-auto mode can quickly stack slash procs to chip away at the health of the enemy, albeit with less damage due to the loss in crits.
**The full-auto mode can also be used to stack corrosive procs to strip away enemy armor before switching back to the semi-auto mode to deal higher damaged shots.
*Building [[status chance]] for the full-auto mode also gives the semi-auto mode a decent amount of [[status chance]].
*A bright energy color is highly recommended, since it will make the highlighting much more visible.  An unusual or contrasting color can be highly effective in brighter tilesets.

==Trivia==
*The Argonak was first revealed during Warframe Partners Shul's and InexpensiveGamer's Twitch stream on October 4th, 2017.
*While reloading the Argonak, clicking the Alt-Fire button will mimick the Incarnon Reload animation.

'''Athodai Prime''' is the [[Prime]]d counterpart of the {{Weapon|Athodai}} handgun, sporting increased Damage, [[Critical Chance]], and [[Status Chance]]. Athodai Prime was released alongside {{WF|Styanax Prime}} and {{Weapon|Afentis Prime}}.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Heat}} damage.
*Primary Fire shoots fully automatic rounds.
**[[Enemy Body Parts|Weak point]] kills with primary fire trigger the '''Overdrive''' buff, increasing [[fire rate]] by '''+100%''', [[Ammo Efficiency|Ammo Efficiency]] by '''+100%''', and decreasing [[Recoil]] by '''-100%''' for '''12''' seconds. 
***'''Overdrive''' buff disables Alternate Fire for its duration, and cannot be refreshed.
***Fire Rate and Recoil bonuses are additive to mods.
*[[Alternate Fire]] shoots a cone of energy, ejecting all remaining ammunition in the magazine in a quick burst.
**Pinpoint [[accuracy]].
**Innate 2 meter [[Punch Through]].
**Cone has a thickness of 2 meters.
**Prevents [[zoom]].
***This prevents the buffs from {{M|Hydraulic Crosshairs}} and {{M|Sharpened Bullets}} from affecting this mode as a result.
*Can equip the Athodai-exclusive {{M|Pain Points}} mod.
*Innate three {{Pol|Madurai}} polarities.

*Alternate Fire consumes 1 ammo per damage tick instead of 0.5, unlike most other continuous weapons.

==Notes==
*'''Overdrive''' buff grants '''+100%''' [[fire rate]], '''-100%''' [[Recoil]], and allows it to consume no ammo while firing, but disables the Alternate Fire feature. The buff lasts for '''12''' seconds.
**The buff triggers on enemy weak point kills, including kills made by hitting weak points generated by {{A|Sonar}} or {{M|Detect Vulnerability}}.
**Overdrive's fire rate buff is additive to other fire rate increases, such as {{M|Gunslinger}}, {{M|Lethal Torrent}}, {{WF|Gauss}}'s {{A|Redline}}, or {{WF|Wisp}}'s Haste {{A|Reservoirs}}.
**Duration '''cannot''' be refreshed.
**Overdrive takes precedence over {{Arcane|Arcane Pistoleer}}, preventing the Arcane from triggering.
*The [[Alternate Fire]] ejects ''all'' of the remaining ammunition in the magazine in a single burst.
**Because of this fact, increasing the magazine size of the weapon such as with {{M|Slip Magazine}} and using recoil reduction mods like {{M|Steady Hands}} can help to make its damage output more consistent and reliable.
**Alternate Fire can be interrupted (preserving the ammunition left in the magazine) by rolling or quick melee.
**Alternate Fire will not function under the effects of any ammo efficiency or infinite ammo buff ([[Energized Munitions]], Overdrive, Arcane Pistoleer, [[Void Fissure#Reactant Buff|Reactant Buff]]), instead firing only for few seconds or not firing at all.
